crossRefs.note: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But…
In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the…
Amaziah also said to Amos, “You seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
but don’t prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house!”

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

translations.web: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”
translations.bsb: At that very hour, some Pharisees came to Jesus and told Him, “Leave this place and get away, because Herod wants to kill You.”
translations.kjv: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
translations.asv: In that very hour there came certain Pharisees, saying to him, Get thee out, and go hence: for Herod would fain kill thee.
